findings.description: none: Moving the isolation hooks to the skills-root conftest makes them apply coherently to both central tests/<skill> suites and in-skill scripts/tests suites. The suite-specific module cache and runtime reactivation directly address collection-order eviction, and the two minimal cross-tree reproducers plus the 4,775-test infrastructure run provide strong regression evidence.

none: Ownership is centralized at the common pytest ancestor while skills/tests/conftest.py remains an explicit ownership marker, avoiding duplicate hook implementations. Every modified path is covered by wp-authority-recovery.write_allow and none matches the package deny glob.
